post.description: Generate a response from a list of OpenAI-compatible messages. Set `stream` to receive server-sent events.

200.description: A JSON completion or an SSE stream when `stream` is true.

x-colibri-queue-wait-ms.description: Milliseconds spent waiting for the engine admission queue.

post.description: Generate text from one prompt using the legacy OpenAI completions shape.

200.description: A JSON completion or an SSE stream when `stream` is true.

post.description: Generate a response with the Anthropic Messages request shape. Unsupported fields are rejected explicitly.

200.description: An Anthropic message or named SSE event stream.

post.description: Text to music, a cover of a clip, a repaint of a span of a clip, any of them in the style of a reference clip (ACE-Step; `GET /v1/models` lists `audio.tasks` and `audio.audio_in`). The answer is a 48 kHz stereo WAV: base64 in JSON, or the file itself with `response_format: "wav"`, or with `stream` an SSE of `music_generation.progress` events (stages `encode`, `text`, `condition`, `denoise`, `decode`) and a `music_generation.completed` event. A clip is a WAV or an MP3 of 1 to 600 s, sent as a file in a multipart/form-data body (`src_audio`, `reference_audio`) or as base64 or a `data:` URL in a JSON body; at most 128 MiB each and 192 MiB together (a multipart body may be that large, a JSON body 4/3 of it). Nothing is fetched from a URL or read from a path. The request names the clips and settings with upstream's own names.

src_audio.description: The clip to cover or repaint, as a file.

reference_audio.description: A clip to take the style from, as a file.

503.description: The queue is full or the music engine is not running

post.description: OpenAI's embeddings request, answered by a Qwen3-Embedding model (`GET /v1/models` lists `embedding.dimensions`, `embedding.min_dimensions` and `embedding.max_tokens`). Each input becomes one unit vector: the last token's hidden state, normalised. `input` is a string or a list of up to 2048 strings (token arrays are refused: the model has its own tokenizer). `dimensions` keeps the first N components and normalises again (1 up to the model's width). `instruction` turns each input into a query for that task (`Instruct: {instruction}\nQuery:{input}`); leave it out for documents. An input longer than `embedding.max_tokens` is cut and listed in `colibri.truncated`, unless `truncate` is `false`, which refuses it. `usage` counts the tokens the model saw, the appended end-of-text token included. A model that does not embed answers 400, and an embedding model answers 400 on every other endpoint. See `docs/embeddings.md`.

200.description: The vectors, in the order of the inputs.

503.description: The queue is full or the embedding engine is not running

post.description: The body Jina's and Cohere's rerank endpoints take, answered by a Qwen3-Reranker model (`GET /v1/models` lists `rerank.max_tokens` and `rerank.max_documents`); `/v1/rerank` and `/v2/rerank` are the same endpoint. Each document is judged against the query with the model's task instruction, and `relevance_score` is the model's chance of answering "yes" (0 to 1). `results` come best first (equal scores keep the order the documents came in); `top_n` keeps the best N and `return_documents` echoes each text. A pair longer than `rerank.max_tokens` has its document cut and is listed in `colibri.truncated`, unless `truncate` is `false`, which refuses it. `usage` counts the tokens of every pair the model read, `top_n` or not. A model that does not rank answers 400, and a reranking model answers 400 on every other endpoint. See `docs/rerank.md`.

200.description: The documents' positions and scores, best first.

503.description: The queue is full or the reranking engine is not running

post.summary: Rank documents against a query (Cohere's path)
post.description: The body Jina's and Cohere's rerank endpoints take, answered by a Qwen3-Reranker model (`GET /v1/models` lists `rerank.max_tokens` and `rerank.max_documents`); `/v1/rerank` and `/v2/rerank` are the same endpoint. get.description: Return the model exposed by this persistent server process.
Return metadata when the path matches the configured model identifier.

get.summary: List the models installed on this machine
get.description: The models found next to the one being served (the setup's models folder, `COLI_MODELS_ROOT`, and the folder holding the served model). `switch` is false when this server was not started by the `coli` launcher and so cannot restart itself on another model. Each entry's `switchable` is the server's own verdict (engine built, KV slots, cluster mode); `reason` says why not. A model is named by `key`, never by path.

200.description: Installed models, the served one first

id.description: The model id the server announces once it serves this model.

verified.description: Every file the setup's download manifest lists is present at its size.

reason.description: Why it cannot be loaded: an engine that is not built, a download that is not finished, a drive that is not connected.

missing.description: Seen on an earlier scan and not found now (`coli router` only). `reason` says why.

unfinished.description: A download that did not finish; `reason` says how many of its files are there.

details.description: What the folder says about itself, read from its small files and the headers of its safetensors files, never the weights: so it is there before the model has ever run (`coli router` only).

context_length.description: The model's own limit in tokens; the server may serve less.

source.description: The repository `coli setup` fetched it from.

reload_seconds.description: How long the model took to load, the slowest of its last three starts (`coli router`, a loaded model).

post.summary: Restart the server on another installed model
post.description: A server serves one model, so this is a restart: the server answers 202, drains its engine, goes away while the new model loads (seconds for small models, many minutes for the largest) and comes back on the same address. Poll `GET /v1/models` until the new `id` appears. If the new model does not start, the launcher returns to the previous one. Refused with 409 while a response is being generated. Requires `Content-Type: application/json` and, from a browser, an allowed origin.

202.description: The server is restarting on the chosen model

409.description: Already the served model, not startable here (`reason`), a response in progress, or a switch already under way

501.description: This server was not started by the `coli` launcher

get.description: Always returns liveness. Authenticated requests also receive scheduler, KV-slot, tier, and hardware details when available.
Return an empty map without valid authentication, or the current expert map and routing hits for an authenticated local dashboard.
Return an empty turn list without valid authentication, or recent per-turn timing and token telemetry for an authenticated local dashboard.
Scheduler counters in the Prometheus text format. Needs the API key when one is set. See `docs/api.md`, Prometheus metrics.

post.description: Text to image (Qwen-Image; `GET /v1/models` lists `capabilities: ["image_generation"]` and the size rules). The answer is a PNG as base64, or with `stream: true` an SSE of `image_generation.progress`, `image_generation.partial_image` and `image_generation.completed` events. Closing the connection cancels the picture. `n` must be 1 and `response_format` can only be `b64_json`; the engine draws one picture at a time, so a full queue answers 503. A gateway also keeps the picture in `~/colibri-images`. See `docs/qwen-image.md`.

partial_images.description: How many small previews to send while streaming; 0 sends none.

seed.description: The seed used; drawn by the server when the request gave none.

post.description: The request of `POST /v1/images/generations` plus one to four pictures to edit, answered (and streamed) the same way. Send what OpenAI's SDKs send, multipart/form-data with the files in `image` (or `image[]`), or JSON with `image` or `images` as base64, a `data:` URL or objects carrying `image_url`. `size` may be left out or `auto`: the engine then follows the last picture. A picture is at most 2048 pixels a side and 4 megapixels, a request at most 32 MiB. Refused with 400, naming the field: no picture, more than four, a `mask`, a URL or a `file_id` (the server fetches nothing and keeps no files). See `docs/qwen-image.md`.

ref_resolution.description: The side the pictures are worked at; the range is in `GET /v1/models`.

200.description: The picture, in the shape of `POST /v1/images/generations`.

post.description: For a model with an audio tower (Gemma 4 E2B or E4B): a WAV or MP3 (and with ffmpeg on the server FLAC, Ogg, M4A and more) of up to 25 MB and 15 minutes becomes text, in the shape Whisper-style clients send. A longer file is cut where it is quietest and the pieces are joined. `srt`, `vtt` and word timestamps are refused. Any other model answers 400 `unsupported_endpoint` with the reason. See `docs/api.md`, Speech to text.

200.description: The text. `json` gives `{text}`, `verbose_json` adds `duration` and `segments`, `text` gives plain text.

post.summary: Answer closed questions with a probability per option
post.description: System One mode: a state and typed questions (`noul`, `choice`, `score`) in, and for every question a probability per option and a `confidence` out, in the request and reply shapes of TypeSafe's Jev. A language model scores the options instead of writing; a decision model (Laya, GLiNER2.5-Decide, Clef) answers natively. See `docs/systemone.md`.

schema.description: A state and the questions, as in `docs/systemone.md`.

200.description: One entry per question, with the probability of each option.

422.description: Valid JSON, but not a question this model can answer.

post.description: Stops a loaded model and frees its memory. One that is answering is told to go as soon as it has finished (202), so a request is never cut off. Only `coli router` has this route; a server that serves one model answers 404.

200.description: Done, or it was not loaded.

202.description: It is answering and goes when it has finished.

get.description: The catalog: every model colibri can fetch, how big it is, what a machine like this one makes of it (`status`, `fits`, `reason`), its licence, whether it is here, and the install job if one is running. See `docs/model-install.md`. Only `coli router` has this route.

license_note.description: Empty when the catalog names no licence.

installed.description: `key`, `id`, `state` of the folder when it is here and whole.

unfinished.description: A download of it was started and is not finished.

roots.description: The models folders; a new model goes in the first with room.

post.description: Starts fetching a catalog model into a models folder, as a background job (202). The caller must have shown the size and the licence: `confirm` has to be `true`. One install runs at a time; a cancelled or failed one keeps what it fetched and asking again continues it. Follow it with `GET /v1/models/installs/{id}`.

id.description: The catalog id of the model being installed.

rate.description: Bytes a second, averaged over this run.

error.description: Why it failed or was cancelled.

409.description: Already installed, another install is running (`install_busy`), no models folder has room (`insufficient_disk`), or another colibri process holds the folder (`model_busy`).

post.description: Stops the install of a model. The part that was fetched is kept.

id.description: The catalog id of the model being installed.

rate.description: Bytes a second, averaged over this run.

error.description: Why it failed or was cancelled.

404.description: That model is not being installed.

get.description: The installs of this router, newest first: running, finished and failed (the last 8).

id.description: The catalog id of the model being installed.

rate.description: Bytes a second, averaged over this run.

error.description: Why it failed or was cancelled.

get.description: The job of one model: its state, bytes done and total, speed and time left.

id.description: The catalog id of the model being installed.

rate.description: Bytes a second, averaged over this run.

error.description: Why it failed or was cancelled.

404.description: That model has no install on record.

post.description: Deletes an installed model's folder, when it is a direct child of a models folder and no engine has it loaded (unload it first). `confirm` has to be `true`. The answer says how much was freed and which presets name the model (they stay, and say the model is not installed).

model.description: What a client names the model, instead of `key`.

409.description: The model is loaded (`model_loaded`), a download is writing it (`model_busy`), its files are in use (`model_in_use`), or it is not inside a models folder (`outside_models_folder`).

get.summary: Read the settings of every model
get.description: Every installed model with whether it is on or off and where it is pinned to run, and the router's GPU policy. See `docs/model-settings.md`. Only `coli router` has this route; a server that serves one model answers 404.

gpu.description: Where the model is pinned to run.

running.description: Where it runs now and why, when it is loaded.

gpu_policy.description: `mode`, `reserve_gb`, `min_gb` and the free and total video memory.

post.summary: Turn a model off or on, or pin where it runs
post.description: Writes the model settings file; takes effect at once. Turning a model off unloads it, or when it has finished what it is answering (`unload` says which). Only `coli router` has this route; a server that serves one model answers 404.

get.description: Every preset in the presets file, whether it can be used and why not, and the entries of the file that were skipped. See `docs/presets.md`. Only `coli router` has this route; a server that serves one model answers 404.

post.description: The body is the preset as the file holds it, plus its `name`. Takes effect at once. 409 when the name is an installed model's own, 404 when its model is not installed. Only `coli router` has this route; a server that serves one model answers 404.

409.description: The name is an installed model's own.

post.description: Takes the preset out of the file. Only `coli router` has this route; a server that serves one model answers 404.

get.description: The last requests the router answered, newest first: when, what, which model, how long, how many tokens, and the `tags` the client put on it (`X-Colibri-Tags`). `enabled` is false when the router was started without a request log. See `docs/request-log.md`. Only `coli router` has this route; a server that serves one model answers 404.

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: Only what carries this tag (`X-Colibri-Tags`, `docs/api.md`, Client tags), as `name:value`; repeat it to need several, all of which must match. Compared as text; only the first colon splits.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many to return, newest first (1 to 500; default 50).

get.summary: List the kept pictures and songs
get.description: Every finished picture the server kept (`~/colibri-images`, `COLI_IMAGE_DIR`) and every song (`~/colibri-music`, `COLI_MUSIC_DIR`), newest first. Each entry says how big the file is and, read from the file's own header, its size (`width`, `height`) or length (`duration`), and the `settings` the server wrote into it (prompt, seed, model...) when it has them. `url` serves the file. Files are never overwritten, so an entry does not change. Both `coli serve` and `coli router` answer this; see `docs/api.md`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: At most this many (1 to 200; default 50).

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Skip this many of the newest (default 0).

total.description: How many files match, over all pages.

settings.description: The record in the file: `app`, `version`, `kind`, `model`, `prompt`, `seed`, `steps`, ... (docs/api.md, Settings inside pictures and songs).

400.description: A parameter is not a number in range, or `kind` is neither `images` nor `music`.

get.summary: Fetch a kept picture or song
get.description: The file itself, with `Cache-Control: private, max-age=86400` (a kept file is never overwritten). A `Range: bytes=a-b` header is answered with 206 so a player can seek. Only a plain file of the right kind directly inside the kept folder is served; any other name is 404, `..` and separators included. Needs the key like everything under `/v1/`, so a page fetches it with the `Authorization` header and shows the bytes from a blob.

416.description: The range lies past the end of the file.

get.description: The pictures and songs asked for with `Prefer: respond-async` on `POST /v1/images/generations`, `POST /v1/images/edits` or `POST /v1/audio/music` (those answer `202` with a job and carry on without the connection), newest first. A job is `queued`, `running`, `succeeded`, `failed` or `cancelled`; one at a time runs. The records are kept on disk (the 200 newest), so the list survives a restart; a job that was waiting or running when the router stopped comes back `failed` with the code `router_restarted`. See `docs/api.md`. Only `coli router` has this route.

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: Only what carries this tag (`X-Colibri-Tags`, `docs/api.md`, Client tags), as `name:value`; repeat it to need several, all of which must match. Compared as text; only the first colon splits.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: At most this many (1 to 200; default 50).

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Skip this many of the newest (default 0).

400.description: A parameter is not a known status or a number in range.

404.description: This server is not a router.

get.description: Where a job is: `queued` (with its `position`, 1 is next), `running` (with `progress` when the engine reports it: `stage`, `step`, `steps`, `elapsed`) or finished. A `succeeded` job has a `result` naming the kept file (`GET /v1/library/{kind}/{name}` serves it); a `failed` one has an `error`. Any client can ask, whenever it likes, so a page that was closed can find its render again.

404.description: No such job (never made, or older than the 200 kept).

post.description: The same call in every state, and never an error for a job that is past help: a waiting job is removed and never runs; a running one has its connection to the model closed, which makes the model stop computing (`status` `cancelling` until the job is read back as `cancelled`); a finished job, or an id nobody knows, answers `cancelled: false` with the status it is in (or `null`).

post.summary: Give the graphics card back and keep running on the CPU
post.description: A model server only (`coli serve`; the router sends it to a worker). Asks an idle model that runs on the graphics card to drop everything it had there, read back into RAM the dense weights only the card held, and carry on on the CPU. Never waits for a request: with one running or waiting the answer is `demoted: false`. Takes seconds. Not undone: the model stays on the CPU until it is stopped. Only the `qwen36` engine can today; any other answers `demoted: false`.

200.description: Whether the card was given back

reason.description: Why not, when `demoted` is false. Nothing was changed.

get.description: The last 2000 lines the router and the models it started printed (a model loading, a start that failed, the GPU giving way to the CPU), oldest first, kept in memory only. Every line has a `seq` that only grows: ask again with `since` set to the `next` of the last answer to get only what came after. `first` is the `seq` of the oldest line still held; a `first` above `since + 1` means lines were dropped. See `docs/router.md`. Only `coli router` has this route; a server that serves one model answers 404.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Only lines after this number (default 0: everything held).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: At most this many (1 to 2000; default 500).

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Only lines from `router` or from this model id.

source.description: `router`, or the id of the model that printed it.

enable_thinking.description: colibrì extension for model reasoning output.

cache_slot.description: colibrì extension selecting an isolated KV context.

x_colibri_ignore_leading_stop.description: Ignore leading stop markers until non-whitespace output begins.

MusicRequest.description: A request for a song. `prompt` or `lyrics` must say something unless this is a cover or a repaint, which work from a clip. For a cover or a repaint the song is as long as the clip (a repaint's silence added) and `duration` is not read.

prompt.description: What the music is like (`caption` is an alias).

language.description: Language of the vocals, like en, zh, ja.

seed.description: The same seed gives the same song.

task.description: `cover` makes the whole clip again in the new style; `repaint` makes only a span of it again and keeps the rest.

src_audio.description: The clip to cover or repaint (required for those tasks): base64 or a `data:` URL of a WAV or MP3, or a file in multipart/form-data.

reference_audio.description: A clip to take the voice and style from, with any task: base64 or a `data:` URL, or a file in multipart/form-data. Clips shorter than 30 s are repeated, longer ones sampled.

audio_cover_strength.description: Cover only: the share of the steps that follow the clip's structure.

cover_noise_strength.description: Cover only: how near the clip the first step starts; 0 starts from noise.

repainting_start.description: Repaint only: where the span starts, in seconds; below 0 adds silence before the clip.

repainting_end.description: Repaint only: where the span ends, in seconds; 0 or less (the default) is the end of the clip, past it adds silence after.

repaint_mode.description: Repaint only: how much of the source the span's edges keep.

repaint_strength.description: Repaint, balanced mode: higher is freer.

input.description: The text to embed: one string, or a list of strings (at most 2048).

encoding_format.description: `base64` is the vector as little-endian float32.

dimensions.description: Keep the first N components and normalise again; at most the model's width.

instruction.description: Makes each input a query for this task; leave out for documents. Colibri's addition.

truncate.description: Cut an input longer than the model takes; `false` refuses it. Colibri's addition.

embedding.description: The unit vector: numbers, or base64 for `encoding_format: base64`.

colibri.description: Present when an input was cut: `truncated`, the indexes of the inputs that were.

query.description: What the documents are judged against (Jina's `{text}` form is taken too).

documents.description: The texts to rank: strings, or objects with a `text` string.

top_n.description: Return only the best N results.

instruction.description: The task the model judges by; the default is web search. Colibri's addition.

truncate.description: Cut a document that makes the pair longer than the model takes; `false` refuses it. Colibri's addition.

colibri.description: Present when a document was cut: `truncated`, the indexes of the documents that were.
What was made: sample_rate, channels, samples, duration, seed, steps, shift, frames, peak, timings, and `task` and `src_seconds` (the source clip's length; 0 for text to music).

features.description: What this server can do (authenticated requests only; an older server has no such block). `api` is the version of the list; `router` is true for `coli router`; `model_switch` is `load` or `restart`; the rest are booleans. See `docs/api.md`, Which features this server has.

Job.description: A picture or song being made apart from the connection that asked for it (`docs/api.md`, Background jobs).

tags.description: The `X-Colibri-Tags` the request carried, when it had any.

request.description: What was asked for: the prompt (cut at 300 characters) and the size, steps, seed, length.

progress.description: While `running`, when the engine reports it: `stage`, `step`, `steps`, `elapsed`.

result.description: When `succeeded` (and for a `cancelled` job that finished anyway).

BadRequest.description: The request is invalid or asks for an unsupported capability.

Unauthorized.description: The configured API key is missing or invalid.

QueueFull.description: The bounded generation queue is full or the request expired while waiting.

NotFound.description: The requested model or route does not exist.
